title: RootModule
summary: The application’s shared root components, data, and metadata.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: Provides default and Layout components, with optional loader, ErrorBoundary, links, meta, shouldRevalidate, id, and loaderPath. id defaults to root for registered root revalidation. loaderPath is an optional application-chosen URL for fetching root data again.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: The example defines a server root module. Do not import server-only loader dependencies into a browser entry; use the file-router integration or provide a browser-safe module separately. Root data is distinct from the active route’s loader data.
